    2^κ modules in every infinite dimension (Corollary 5.7) #

    Applying the representation embedding of Theorem 5.2 to the Göbel–Simson family T_β, β ⊆ κ (Theorem 5.6), gives 2^κ pairwise non-isomorphic indecomposable modules of dimension κ with local endomorphism rings whose radicals satisfy the nilpotence bound of the retractions (EmbeddingData.exists_noniso_family). For β ≠ γ one of Hom(T_β, T_γ), Hom(T_γ, T_β) vanishes, so T_β ≇ T_γ, and the embedding reflects isomorphism classes.

    ∃ (ι : Type u) (T : ι → Statement.Kron k) (hT : ∀ (i : ι), IsBrickKron (T i)) (hinf : ∀ (i : ι), Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ (T i).dim), Cardinal.mk ι = 2 ^ κ ∧ (∀ (i : ι), (T i).dim = κ) ∧ ∀ (i j : ι), Nonempty (↑(FT E ⋯ ⋯) ≃ₗ[A] ↑(FT E ⋯ ⋯)) → i = j

    2^κ Kronecker bricks of dimension κ whose images under F are pairwise non-isomorphic.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.endLocalBounded_FT {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (E : EmbeddingData k A) {T : Statement.Kron k} (hT : IsBrickKron T) (hinf : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ T.dim) :
    Statement.EndLocalBounded k A (E.n + 1) ↑(FT E hT hinf)
